skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Weißer Sand
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Weißer Sand. Home leisure style, a present from Carnelian to Beeswax. She believed this one would fit her most, and knew Beeswax would like it.
skins.quote: There were a few fashion experts shopping alongside who betted that this outfit wouldn't work on Beeswax, and they very clearly lost.

skins.name: Holiday HD61
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Holiday Series HD61. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and lightweight. Allows you to enjoy a perfect beach experience in absolute relaxation.
skins.quote: Before, her towers could only be formed with sand, but now they come in pure white, adorned with fresh flowers.
